decision.explanation: The question 'When was Judge Howe born?' refers to multiple distinct individuals named 'Judge Howe' found in the source documents. Document 1 and Card 0 identify Harland Bradley Howe as a federal judge born on February 19, 1873. Document 2 and Card 1 identify another Harland Bradley Howe (same name, different record) as a federal judge born on July 15, 1875. Document 3 and Card 2 identify James Henry Howe as a federal judge born on December 5, 1827. Since the query does not specify a first name or middle initial, and the sources provide distinct valid birth dates for three different people holding the title 'Judge Howe', all three dates are retained as separate valid answers corresponding to distinct referents.
